# awscc_deadline_budget (Resource)

Creates a budget to set spending thresholds for your rendering activity.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Attributes List) The budget actions to specify what happens when the budget runs out. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `approximate_dollar_limit` (Number) The dollar limit based on consumed usage.
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the budget.
- `farm_id` (String) The farm ID.
- `schedule` (Attributes) The start and end time of the budget. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `usage_tracking_resource` (Attributes) The usage details of the allotted budget. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage_tracking_resource))

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the budget.
- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the budget.
- `budget_id` (String) The budget ID.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the budget.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `threshold_percentage` (Number) The percentage threshold for the budget action.
- `type` (String) The type of budget action.

Optional:

- `description` (String) A description for the budget action.


<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `fixed` (Attributes) The details of a fixed budget schedule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule--fixed))

<a id="nestedatt--schedule--fixed"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule.fixed`

Required:

- `end_time` (String) When the budget ends.
- `start_time` (String) When the budget starts.



<a id="nestedatt--usage_tracking_resource"></a>
### Nested Schema for `usage_tracking_resource`

Required:

- `queue_id` (String) The queue ID.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_deadline_budget.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

#### Optional
